report.summary: crates/link-annotations rev 2: preserved the rev-1 URI allowlist (http/https/mailto only, mixed-case-bypass test, length-check-before-parse) byte-for-byte untouched (uri.rs has zero diff). Added source::SourceIdentity binding each annotation to an exact revision id + FNV-1a content hash + byte range, with check_fresh() returning typed Staleness (RevisionChanged/ContentChanged/RangeInvalid) when checked against a different revision or edited source; byte ranges are validated as UTF-8 char-boundary-safe against real source text at bind time and re-check time (tested with CJK multi-byte source). Added page::PageTarget (PageIndex + Rect), a pure data model with no I/O; LabelSet now maps each label to its PageTarget and a resolved InternalTarget carries it. Unresolved labels remain a typed TargetError::Unresolved, never a dangling destination. LinkAnnotation now carries a SourceIdentity instead of a bare SourceSpan.
